_about: Legendary monsters, read by sim/AssetLibrary.cs and sim/Legends.cs (docs/LEGENDS.md). Each is unique: at most one in a world. title: what the peoples call its kind. sprite: base name in assets/sprites/creatures/ (drawn by art/legends.py), one image per pose. lair: biomes (names from scripts/world/biomes.gd) where it sleeps and wakes. chance: odds that a new world holds it (it must also have its lair). wake: the years between which it wakes. health: how much it takes to slay it. strength: how hard it strikes. speed: tiles per second. roam: how far (tiles) from its lair it ranges and looks for prey and villages. power: what its strikes do (fire, stomp, roots, raise_dead, quake, lightning). domain and deed: the god and the myth its deeds give the peoples who live through them. temper: wrath, greed, cunning, pride (0..1), what its mind leans to. names: syllables its name is made of (one from the first half, one from the second). lore: what is told of it.

legends.title: Ash Wyrm
legends.lore: A great dragon asleep beneath the burning mountains, who wakes to hoard the gold of the peoples.

legends.title: Frost Titan
legends.lore: A giant of the frozen north, older than the first fire, who walks where the snow never melts.

legends.title: Elder Treant
legends.lore: The oldest tree of the world, which uproots itself when the forests are in danger.

legends.title: Hollow King
legends.lore: A king who would not die, crowned in bone, who wakes to raise a kingdom of the dead.

legends.title: Sand Colossus
legends.lore: A giant of sandstone carved with runes no people can read, that wakes when the desert winds call it.

legends.title: Storm Roc
legends.lore: A bird as large as a hall, nesting on the highest peaks, that brings the storm on its wings.
